name: devin-vpn
description: Devin DevBox can't reach internal services. Run from inside the DevBox via the session terminal.

commands.command: pgrep -a openvpn; pgrep -a wg-quick; pgrep -a tailscale 2>/dev/null || echo '(no VPN process found)'
ip addr show | grep -A2 -E 'tun|tap|wg|tailscale' || echo '(no tunnel interface)'

commands.description: Probe internal service by IP (replace 10.0.0.1 with your service)
commands.command: echo '(edit this command for your internal service IP)'; nc -zvw3 10.0.0.1 443 2>&1 | head -5

commands.description: Probe internal service by name (replace with yours)
commands.command: echo '(edit this command for your internal service hostname)'; getent hosts staging.internal.example.com 2>&1

commands.description: Recent OpenVPN log (if openvpn-systemd-resolved or systemd unit)
commands.command: journalctl -u openvpn* -n 20 --no-pager 2>/dev/null | tail -30 || echo '(no openvpn journal)'
